title: 2006 to Now: Jamia Promises Union Polls #Shorts
description:
Jamia promised student union elections, but gave no date. Its student union was dissolved in 2006. A Registrar's order on Monday, 26 October says polls will be held 15 days after a new union constitution is approved, and there is no deadline for that approval. The order also revokes suspensions and show-cause notices from the protest and sets up a committee on security staff conduct. Students dispute the order's account of an undertaking by protesters, and some kept up their hunger strike.

Will Jamia name a date? Reply A for Yes or B for No in the comments. Follow for daily world news explained.

Sources: ANI, PTI (via Hans India), Outlook, Millennium Post, India TV.
Footage: stock and Wikimedia Commons clips for illustration (Pixabay, Wikimedia Commons), not of the actual event.
